crossRefs.note: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man…
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be…
“Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly…
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

translations.web: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
translations.bsb: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
translations.kjv: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
translations.asv: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.
